act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (1) of section 144, for the words and brackets “any other Magistrate
text:
37. In sub-section (1) of section 144, for the words and brackets “any other Magistrate

(not being a Magistrate of the third class)”, the words “any other Executive Magistrate” shall be
substituted.
